sizing: Member bytes include parameters, train-only scales, schema and NumPy headers; parameter bytes count floats alone.
memory_note: Peak RSS includes interpreter, optimizer, input caches and CPU allocator. GPU allocator counters cover framework tensors only; driver, other jobs and full machine memory are outside their scope.

optimization.optimizer: AdamW, one global mean over task losses, clip global norm 2, weight decay 0.001. Gradients propagate through every task head and the shared temporal attention by reverse-mode automatic differentiation.

runtime.method: Single observed development case on CPU per task. Cold end-to-end is median of three fresh processes including Python, NumPy, reading checkpoint and case, and first prediction. Warm median and p95 over 60 calls after 5 warmups, including model preprocessing and decoding. Excludes sensor capture, feature extraction, user interface and transport. Timing varies by machine.

flops_note: Nominal FP multiply/add count for one input shape, counting one multiply-accumulate as two. Includes linear maps and attention score/value products. Excludes normalization, masking, exponentials, biases, activations, data movement and framework overhead. FLOPs per training update were not measured.

human_leg_emg.context: Five consecutive 32-sample bins at 256 Hz. Cutoff c=ceil(rotation onset in samples)+32; c-159 through c. Each sacrum value is relative to c, available at issue. EEG missing site is NaN for both moments.
human_leg_emg.output: Eight measured channel RMS voltages over c+1..c+32 (125 ms).

human_sacrum_path.context: Five consecutive 32-sample bins at 256 Hz. Cutoff c=ceil(rotation onset in samples)+32; c-159 through c. Each sacrum value is relative to c, available at issue. EEG missing site is NaN for both moments.
human_sacrum_path.output: Time-major XYZ sacrum displacement from c at samples +8,+16,+24,+32 (31.25, 62.5, 93.75, 125 ms).

landmark_motion.context: Five consecutive timed camera frames. Per-point coordinates relative to its current location, pooled offsets of matched currently eligible points, and current point relative to visible body centroid; divide by the physical radius measured at the issue frame. No atlas point or skeleton correspondence across recordings.
landmark_motion.output: One optical point's 2D displacement at nearest source frame to the requested 120 ms (200 ms for the 5-Hz locust camera), tolerance 40 ms. Model and extrapolator use nominal duration fixed by recording protocol. Native-unit reversal multiplies by stored per-origin body radius.

macaque_cortex_to_motion.context: 20 consecutive completed 10-ms bins from k-20 through k-1. Optical marker positions converted from metres and handle from cm into mm. All available local sorts, including sort zero, summed once on each of 37 predeclared acquisition contacts; original guide differs across days.
macaque_cortex_to_motion.output: Endpoint displacement relative to k-1 at k+9 (100 ms).

macaque_motion_to_cortex.context: 20 consecutive completed 10-ms bins from k-20 through k-1. Optical marker positions converted from metres and handle from cm into mm. All available local sorts, including sort zero, summed once on each of 37 predeclared acquisition contacts; original guide differs across days.
macaque_motion_to_cortex.output: Summed source-observed contact spike counts for k through k+9 (100 ms).

optical_fluorescence.context: Four measured points nearest −3.6, −2.4, −1.2 and 0 s from forecast issue, tolerances 0.36 s; grid every 1.2 s. First 32 ROIs, first 180 s, origin >=30 s. First 30 s only establish the established finite and nonconstant eligibility condition for each ROI.
optical_fluorescence.output: Next optical value at approximately +1.2 s, error tolerance 0.36 s, unit of this assay's training-history SD.

rat_next_unit.context: Trial-local cumulative counts and three exponentially decayed counts through the last completed occupied 1-ms bin; all source candidates retained, including inactive rows. The fifth feature marks the most recent completed bin.
rat_next_unit.output: Source candidate in next occupied complete 1-ms bin, conditional on exactly one spike there. Multiple events unresolved; last issue censored at trial end. Forecast receives no target clock or future gap.
